title.en: An Act Declaring March 19 and June 21 of Each Year as Special Working Holidays in the Municipality of Narra, Palawan
title.orig: An Act Declaring March 19 and June 21 of Each Year as Special Working Holidays in the Municipality of Narra, Palawan

text.en: March 19 and June 21 are respectively the town fiesta and founding anniversary of the Municipality of Narra, Province of Palawan. Both occasions are celebrated by the townspeople to galvanize them around activities involving their cultural progress and socioeconomic development.
March 19 and June 21 are hereby declared special working holidays in the Municipality of Narra, Province of Palawan.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
